title: STEADY HAND AND BEAST MODE
why: His 10-29 order: steady hand and beast mode, up to 15% each. Watch: steady hand and beast mode, up to 15% each; active reload at 15% makes the top combined round x1.520875, or +52.0875% damage. Air strike kills count for their owner, capped at 15; watch the five-second ring and immediate steady hand reset on any hit or gun change in both windows.
now: Steady hand adds 1% damage per kill until hit or gun change. Beast mode adds 1% per kill within five seconds. Both cap at 15 and multiply with active reload.
